title: The genetic overlap between schizophrenia and major depression with cognitive function
title_zh: 精神分裂症与重度抑郁症与认知功能的遗传重叠
abstract: This study aimed to systematically dissect the shared genetic basis of schizophrenia (SCZ) and major depression (MD) with cognitive function. To investigate this, we integrated large-scale genome-wide association studies (GWAS) summary statistics for SCZ (N = 175,799, [cases, 74,776; controls, 101,023]), MD (N = 2,622,273 [cases, 550,355; controls, 2,071,918]) and four cognitive traits (reaction time, N = 330,069; memory, N = 112,067; verbal-numerical reasoning, N = 36,035; educational attainment, N = 111,114). Linkage disequilibrium (LD) score regression analysis revealed that SCZ showed significant negative genetic correlations with reaction time, memory, and verbal-numerical reasoning. MD showed negative genetic correlations with memory, verbal-numerical reasoning, and educational attainment. Bayesian colocalization analysis identified seven genomic regions with strong or supportive evidence between SCZ and cognitive function, and two genomic regions with supportive evidence between MD and cognitive function. Gene mapping and over representation analysis (ORA) indicated that SCZ-associated genes were primarily involved in pathways related to transport processes, and MD-associated genes were significantly enriched in pathways related to neural development. Through genetic correlation and colocalization analysis, this study elucidates the genetic overlap between SCZ and MD with cognitive function, providing a new perspective for related research.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在系统性剖析精神分裂症（SCZ）与重度抑郁症（MD）与认知功能之间的共享遗传基础。为此，我们整合了大规模全基因组关联研究（GWAS）摘要统计数据：SCZ（N = 175,799，病例 74,776；对照 101,023），MD（N = 2,622,273，病例 550,355；对照 2,071,918）以及四项认知特征（反应时间 N = 330,069；记忆 N = 112,067；言语-数值推理 N = 36,035；教育成就 N = 111,114）。连锁不平衡（LD）得分回归分析显示，SCZ 与反应时间、记忆和言语-数值推理呈显著负遗传相关；MD 与记忆、言语-数值推理和教育成就呈负遗传相关。贝叶斯共定位分析识别出七个基因组区段在 SCZ 与认知功能之间具有强或支持性证据，两个基因组区段在 MD 与认知功能之间具有支持性证据。基因映射与富集分析（ORA）表明，SCZ 相关基因主要涉及运输过程相关通路，而 MD 相关基因显著富集于神经发育相关通路。通过遗传相关性与共定位分析，本研究阐明了 SCZ 与 MD 与认知功能之间的遗传重叠，为相关研究提供了新的视角。
